title: Why does a failed TaskGroup task cancel its siblings?
summary: TaskGroup treats its tasks as one unit of work: a non-cancellation failure starts a coordinated shutdown before the group reports errors.1

title: What happens when one TaskGroup task fails?
summary: TaskGroup asks unfinished tasks to stop, waits for them to finish, then reports the errors. A child ending with CancelledError alone does not trigger this.1
